title: Why is there no DLC for RPG Maker releases before VX Ace ?

posts.author: Banana_Duck
posts.body:
MZ: 800+ on Steam, almost 1,000 on Komodo Plaza
MV: 1,000+ on Steam, almost 1,000 on Komodo Plaza
VX Ace: 400+ on Steam, 500+ on Komodo Plaza
Even VN Maker has over 300 DLCs on Komodo, mostly music and SFX, but DLC nonetheless.
VX and older engines, on the other hand? Nothing.
It's not like nobody uses these engines either, I know plenty of folks who still use XP for example.
Do you think there's a reason why?

posts.author: Timtrack
posts.body: I think VX Ace was the first RPG Maker engine added to steam and so the first one to receive dlcs. The older engines were added more as a legacy to allow users to get them or something?

posts.author: TeiRaven
posts.body:
Because it wasn't the favored commercial model at the time. And also, most people were hobbyists at the time--no one was inclined to pay for RMXP resources because everyone was making and sharing their work for free. By the time DLC became popular as a concept and people were starting to sell resources, XP was pretty much considered too old to bother. And there were already so many spectacular free resources (Sithjester, Avery, Lunarea, Pandamaru...) that I expect the powers that be probably thought that no one would buy them.
There's exactly one official XP DLC I know of: if you get the Steam version (possibly also the new stand-alone?) it includes an RTP-style exterior tileset from Lunarea, with some extremely cute flowers and (iirc) a tree house.
Kokoro Reflections does have 32px versions of their tiles, but you have to buy them direct from KR. The ones available from Deciga or Komodo Plaza or whatever the shop is called these days are the 48px versions only.

posts.author: Poryg
posts.body: VXAce was the first engine where people began to go commercial. Prior to that, it was mostly hobbyists. And resources for rm2k/rm2k3 are scarce and even were scarce back then due to different color palette (256 colors) and fixed sprite dimensions. If you wanted quality assets for rm2k/2k3, you needed to go for rips of copyrighted material.
